summary: Wolf walked by window strutting along woods' edge Many will no tbelieve Claim Grey Wolves don't roam in Connecticut Tell me Coyotoe or a Coywolf hopefully I can hunt some tracks or scat truth in steps or poop #poemsofpresence #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Wolf walked by window
strutting along
woods'
edge
Many will no tbelieve
Claim Grey Wolves
don't roam in Connecticut
Tell me Coyotoe
or a
Coywolf
hopefully I can hunt some
tracks or scat
truth in steps or
poop
#poemsofpresence
#smallpoems
